location: Đường Chính Hữu, phường An Hải, TP. Đà Nẵng
content:
TERRA VERDE is envisioned as a premium serviced apartment development where contemporary architecture blends seamlessly with nature to create a new standard of urban living.

Inspired by the philosophy of “green living, refined living,” the project incorporates vertical greenery and open spaces throughout the design, providing a healthy, private, and nature-connected living environment. Every architectural element is carefully considered to enhance comfort, maximize natural light and ventilation, and foster a harmonious relationship between residents and the surrounding landscape.

More than simply offering high-end accommodation, TERRA VERDE is designed to promote a sustainable lifestyle where aesthetics, functionality, and environmental responsibility coexist in perfect balance. The project reflects a commitment to creating a modern living experience that is both elegant and environmentally conscious.
